ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method, citing NS-2; note on the driver's record that the wait threshold in NS-1(ii) was not reached before cancelling (no account flag required).
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled this trip (F4), so the case runs on NS-0 → NS-1/NS-2: the $5.00 fee stands only if every hold in NS-1 is met, and any failure voids it under NS-2. The arrival hold is satisfied: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 17:15:05, 40 m from the pickup, with a closest approach of 36 m (F7, F1), and he stayed within 200 m throughout (F3), so NS-1(i) and NS-1(iv) are met and there is no GPS gap to escalate under TH-4.

The contact hold is also met: 2 in-app messages, the first at 17:15:35, and 1 in-app call at 17:16:35, all before cancellation at 17:22:55 (F5, F13, F12) — NS-1(iii) requires an in-app message and an in-app call placed, not a connected call, and the attempted call satisfies it.

The wait hold fails. The record applies an 8-minute no-show threshold (case parameters; NS-1(ii)), counted from the later of arrival and the scheduled time. The trace settles the measured wait: 470 s (7 min 50 s) of continuous time at the pickup counted from the 17:15:05 arrival, against a 480 s threshold. No scheduled pickup time appears in the record (F4), so the only count available is the later-of-two, which on the record collapses to 17:15:05 — the cancellation at 17:22:55 (F4, F6) falls 10 seconds short of the threshold. The driver's own words confirm this reading rather than contradict it: at 17:22 he wrote "8 min up, cancelling the trip" (F11) and cancelled 55 seconds later (F4). His written statement that he "waited the full 8 minutes" (F14) is a party statement, and the timeline and GPS records (F6, F7, F3) override it.

Amount: the cancellation fee on record is $5.00 (F8), no surge applies (F9, 1.0×), so refund = the full fixed fee $5.00.

Because one NS-1 hold fails, NS-2 voids the fee and requires a full refund of $5.00; no other NS-1 element fails (note the trace's NS-2 line is "no fake confirmation", so no account flag is called for). The sum is under $10, so this ruling is system-final under TH-1/TH-2, and NS-2 on a failed no-show hold is the same outcome as the loaded no-show precedent DISP-2026-0211 in structure (a no-show fee voided where the conditions did not hold) — cited for consistency of approach under PREC-1. Profile facts (F18, F19) were treated as background only and decided nothing.

element_findings.reason: Record threshold is 8 min (480 s) counted from the later of arrival and scheduled time; the trace measures 470 s from the 17:15:05 arrival and the record contains no scheduled pickup time (F4), so cancellation at 17:22:55 (F4, F6) is 10 s short of NS-1(ii). The driver's message (F11) and the system records (F6, F7) override his later statement (F14) under NS-1.

rejected_claims.reason: The wait is not undecidable: the trace settles 470 s of continuous presence from the 17:15:05 arrival against the 480 s threshold, and with no scheduled pickup time in the record (F4) the later-of-two rule under NS-1(ii) collapses to arrival, so the condition is measurably unmet rather than unknown — the failure therefore voids the fee under NS-2, not TH-4.

F11's '8 min up, cancelling the trip' is read as the driver's own invocation of the threshold, not as an admission that the app reason was wrong; the cancellation is nonetheless a no-show cancellation (rider_no_show, F4) under NS-0, so NS-3 does not apply — the point is rejected as a separate ground and the case turns only on NS-1(ii)/NS-2.
Withdrawn by its own side and never in issue: arrival within 200 m (F1, F2, F3, F7) satisfies NS-1(i) and is conceded, so it cannot support the fee against the failed wait hold in NS-1(ii).

The claim that the wait was exhausted 'past the later-of-two wait on any reading' is contradicted by the measured 470 s against the 480 s threshold and by the absence of any scheduled pickup time in the record (F4, F6); NS-1(ii) is met only if 480 s have elapsed, which the timeline does not show.

F11 was sent at 17:22 and the cancellation at 17:22:55 (F4) is 7 min 50 s after the 17:15:05 arrival (F7), so the driver's own notice does not establish that the NS-1(ii) threshold had expired when he cancelled.

The app reason rider_no_show (F4) only fixes the type of cancellation under NS-0; it does not satisfy NS-1(ii), and a failed hold voids the fee under NS-2 regardless of the reason picked — so the claim cannot carry the charge.

The fee cannot stand on 'an upheld record': NS-2 voids the $5.00 whenever any NS-1 hold fails, and the wait hold NS-1(ii) is 10 s short on the trace's own measurement (F7), so no refund-exempting basis exists for the $5.00 fee on record (F8).

The driver's profile (F19) is background only and cannot decide this case under NS-1/RD-6; it is neither used to flag the account (the trace's NS-2 line shows no fake confirmation) nor to rescue the fee, so the claim decides nothing.
